checks.reason: 7 GPUs visible to nvidia-smi, 8 expected (lspci sees more: a GPU has likely fallen off the bus)
checks.fix: Drain the node, collect nvidia-bug-report.sh, reseat or RMA the missing GPU.

checks.title: GPU model matches what was sold
No hardware clock throttling
checks.fix: Check cooling, fans, PSU and power capping on this node; drain until clocks recover.

checks.title: GPU temperatures within limits
checks.reason: GPU temperature at or above 87 C on GPU 5

checks.title: No uncorrectable ECC errors
checks.fix: Drain the node, reset the GPU (nvidia-smi -r) and run dcgmi diag -r 3; RMA if it repeats.

checks.title: No pending page retirement / row remapping
checks.fix: Failed remap: RMA the GPU. Pending: drain and reset the GPU.

checks.title: GPU PCIe link at full width
checks.reason: Link generation may drop at idle; that is normal

checks.title: All NVLink links up
checks.fix: Check fabric manager and NVSwitch health; drain the node.

checks.title: No critical XID events this boot
checks.reason: XID 48 on 0000:3a:00 (Double-bit ECC error); XID 79 on 0000:9a:00 (GPU has fallen off the bus)
checks.fix: Drain the node; XID 79/48/95/64 need a GPU reset or RMA.

checks.title: All RDMA ports active

checks.fix: Check cable/transceiver and switch port; drain the node until the rail is back.
